verdict.rationale: Smithery provides its own discovery capability. The maintained CLI offers `smithery mcp search [term]` and `smithery tool find [query]` against a registry described as "thousands of skills and MCP servers," and the public registry stays live after the 2026-10-31 shutdown. Coverage is still partial, not complete. Search is keyword-only, with no documented capability-based filtering or faceting. Tool-level browsing appears tied to connections, which cuts against discovering tools "before wiring anything." The registry's HTTP endpoint is undocumented, and the docs and server-page surfaces were removed with the shutdown. Missing for 10: documented capability or category filtering, documented tool browsing without a connection, a documented registry API or browse UI after shutdown, and independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
Smithery will remain as a public (non-proxied) MCP registry.
The maintained CLI commands are the only documented discovery surface against the public registry.
